description: Version updates of the platform (ADR-022): GitHub Actions (pinned to commit SHAs), Helm charts and images of the kustomizations, manifests installed from a release URL, pre-commit hooks. The releases of llmops-gateway arrive the same way, through their X.Y.Z image tags (ADR-023).

customManagers.description: Manifests installed from a release URL, with the version in the path only
CloudNativePG's manifest has its version in the file name too
Sloth's image in the script that generates the SLO rules

packageRules.description: Major versions of the platform's operators and charts need a reading of their upgrade notes
Releases of llmops-gateway (ADR-023): one PR for both images, created first and outside the PR limits, so a release never waits behind third-party updates

A patch release of llmops-gateway is merged by Renovate once every check has passed, the gateway-release job included. No branch protection on the repo, so Renovate merges itself rather than through GitHub's auto-merge
